    for line in tsv_data.splitlines():
        yield line.encode()

# Test if the TSV data is correctly validated and parsed
try:
    reader = GermlineTSVReader(mock_read_tsv_data())
    sheet = reader.read_sheet()
    print("Test passed: Patient name with hyphen is correctly validated and parsed.")
